name: 圣光降临
description: 选择6格内1个地格。该格中的友军治疗7点，敌军受到7点法术伤害；距离1格的单位治疗或受到4点法术伤害；距离2格的单位治疗或受到2点法术伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { const sourcePiece = context.piece; const targetCell = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 6 }); if (!targetCell || targetCell.needsTargetSelection) { return targetCell; } const battle = context.battle; const centerX = targetCell.x; const centerY = targetCell.y; const getPiecesAtDist = function(dist) { return battle.pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.currentHp > 0 && Math.abs(p.x - centerX) + Math.abs(p.y - centerY) === dist; }); }; const applyRing = function(pieces, value) { const allies = pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId === sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId; }); const enemies = pieces.filter(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId !== sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId; }); if (allies.length > 0) healDamage(sourcePiece, allies, value, battle, context.skill.id); if (enemies.length > 0) dealDamage(sourcePiece, enemies, value, 'magical', battle, context.skill.id); }; applyRing(getPiecesAtDist(0), 7); applyRing(getPiecesAtDist(1), 4); applyRing(getPiecesAtDist(2), 2); return { message: sourcePiece.name + '释放了圣光降临', success: true }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { return { description: '选择6格内1个地格。该格中的友军治疗7点，敌军受到7点伤害；距离1格的单位治疗或受到4点；距离2格的单位治疗或受到2点。', expectedValues: { centerHeal: 7, centerDamage: 7, adjacentHeal: 4, adjacentDamage: 4, distantHeal: 2, distantDamage: 2 } }; }
